title: BERAG: Bayesian Ensemble Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-based Visual Question Answering
abstract: arXiv:2604.22678v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A common approach to question answering with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is to concatenate documents into a single context and pass it to a language model to generate an answer. While simple, this strategy can obscure the contribution of individual documents, making attribution difficult and contributing to the ``lost-in-the-middle'' effect, where relevant information in long contexts is overlooked. Concatenation also scales poorly: computational cost grows quadratically with context length, a problem that becomes especially severe when the context includes visual data, as in visual question answering. Attempts to mitigate these issues by limiting context length can further restrict performance by preventing models from benefiting from the improved recall offered by deeper retrieval. translated_title: BERAG：用于基于知识的视觉问答的贝叶斯集成检索增强生成
translated_abstract: 在检索增强生成（RAG）问答中，一种常见方法是将文档拼接成单一上下文，再传递给语言模型以生成答案。这种方法虽然简单，但可能掩盖单个文档的贡献，使归因变得困难，并导致“迷失在中间”效应，即长上下文中的相关信息被忽视。此外，拼接方式的可扩展性较差：计算成本随上下文长度呈二次方增长，当上下文包含视觉数据时（如视觉问答场景），这一问题尤为严重。通过限制上下文长度来缓解这些问题的尝试，反而可能因阻止模型受益于更深层次检索带来的更高召回率而进一步限制性能。我们提出了贝叶斯集成检索增强生成（BERAG）以及贝叶斯集成微调（BEFT），作为一种RAG框架……
tldr: 该论文提出BERAG框架，通过贝叶斯集成方式替代传统的文档拼接方法进行检索增强生成，解决了长上下文中的“迷失在中间”效应和二次方计算成本问题，并结合BEFT微调方法应用于基于知识的视觉问答任务。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes BERAG, a Bayesian ensemble RAG framework that replaces document concatenation to mitigate the lost-in-the-middle effect and quadratic computational cost, together with Bayesian Ensemble Fine-Tuning (BEFT), for knowledge-based visual question answering.
